title: An Offer of Wings
text: A tall thing with too many feathers stands in the path. It looks you over, all of you, the way a buyer looks over stock at a fair, counting teeth. Its eyes settle on the lightest of you. It wants them, it says, and it will pay in wings.

options.label: Let it choose the lightest of you, and pay whatever price comes with wings.

outcomes.text: It wraps its chosen in its wings. When it lets go they move like the wind, though they will not say what they saw within the feathers.
It takes something in trade and will not say what. They feel lighter for it, yet some piece of knowledge they once held is gone.

options.label: Tell it no, and hold your ground. Your own are not for sale.

outcomes.text: It shrugs all its feathers at once and is gone. A single feather stays caught on the Leader's collar, lightening their step for the next fight.
It does not like that answer. All its feathers rise at once.

options.label: The Vagabond haggles it down to a single feather, with a grin and a bold tongue.

outcomes.text: Charmed by such cheek, it pays the Vagabond for the pleasure of the haggling: a single feather, with the light step that comes with it.
